name: Production office space
description:
This dataset lists 25 production office and studio spaces, primarily audio and film/television facilities, located in Manhattan, New York. Each row represents one studio and includes its name, street address, ZIP code, phone number, fax, website, and email contact. Many records also include geographic details such as latitude and longitude, borough, community board and council districts, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot number (BBL), and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). Contact and location fields are mostly complete, while the geographic identifiers are missing for roughly half the rows.

The data could be used to find and contact production or recording studios in Manhattan, map studio locations by neighborhood or district, compare studio density across ZIP codes, or support location scouting and vendor research for film, television, and audio production. It could also serve as a starting point for broader directories of creative production spaces in New York City.
